project.name: Canon Ledger
project.summary: A WebMCP belief-state debugger for game narrative designers: agents trace rumors and per-NPC beliefs at scale, stage canon changes, and commit only operations approved in the current page-review state without erasing intentional misconceptions.
project.ai_usage: A supported ChatGPT/Codex agent is the natural-language client for five narrow WebMCP tools; deterministic page code computes beliefs, provenance, registered-condition projections, review authority, and commit validity.
project.codex_usage: Codex consolidated the scope and specifications, implemented the TypeScript product, generated and tested the deterministic fixture, verified browser runtime behavior, and integrated adversarial review findings.
